purpose: Teacher-only prerequisites for four draft Igbo listening/production tasks; unfilled, not a delivered examination or review certificate.
steps: A competent native Igbo examiner checks intended local pronunciations of aka, efere, mmiri and the isolated/a f m/sound models. The model must be an actual audible production, not merely written letters.

Check instructions, child familiarity, hearing/access route, intelligibility, acceptable local variants and rubric before use. These author criteria do not prescribe a national accommodation or grading policy. If the sound contrast/model is unsuitable or ambiguous, do not administer or score; revise and review the draft.
Use exact task-specific examiner-only words/models. Do not display word lists or keys for001/002. Produce target speech sounds rather than letter names; do not add a vowel to an isolated consonant.

Hear each individual response and assess only the stated target and criteria. For003 include original connected speech. For004 give truthful feedback, do not invent an error, and hear final production/explanation.

Any retained evidence follows school consent/privacy policy. This repository stores no learner identity, recording or performance result. An unfilled protocol or model answer cannot establish delivery.
Native/academic review, model calibration, audio playback/accessibility/app delivery, full sound/word range, notation, source unit definition, school adoption and official term placement remain open.
